mustard.en: This isn’t really true. British cooking historically used loads of spices: black pepper, ginger, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves, mustard, and mace.
mustard.zh: 这其实并不是真的。英国烹饪历史上使用过大量的香料：黑椒、生姜、肉豆蔻、肉桂、丁香、芥末和肉豆蔻衣。

mustard.en: A roast joint of beef would usually just be seasoned with salt and pepper, some herbs as well, and then served with vegetables and gravy and perhaps horseradish or mustard.
mustard.zh: 一块烤牛肉通常只用盐和胡椒、一些草本植物调味，然后配上蔬菜、肉汁，也许还有辣根或芥末。

mushroom.en: For breakfast, you can try full English breakfasts: eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, mushrooms, tomatoes, and toast, sometimes black pudding as well.
mushroom.zh: 早餐方面，你可以尝试英式全套早餐：鸡蛋、培根、香肠、焗豆、蘑菇、西红柿和吐司，有时还有黑布丁。
